scope: Public init bind reconciliation-host transport, native failure custody projection, exact selector contract projection and provision-only policy activation
native_failure_projection: Module-private WeakMap keyed only by actual branded handle, same live authority scope, one-use deletion.
Exported interrupt accepts no caller identity/provider/effect data, performs no reads/writes, closes and zeros private state, and may retain custody after ordinary handle terminal.
Known owned identity list contains only identities observed by native publisher.
Never infer no effects from empty owned list: retain native indeterminate standing when effect entered before identity capture.
EOF/wrong token after seed must retain seed custody and report indeterminate exit6, without rollback or cleanup claims; historical cancel API stays unchanged.
transport: Separate native-provision transport with exact original argv, exact selector, live three-TTY, actual init bind/local-write scope and Architect/write/json controls.
At most seed READY, issuer READY, one terminal; issuer-existing or seed-existing paths use native result state.
No issuer/seed/private bytes, no raw private documents, no generic resource or write callback.
Authority finalizer failure cannot erase previously captured created/indeterminate owned identities or downgrade uncertainty.
P1 output transport unchanged; unrelated commands unchanged.
activation: Canonical init bind local-write upper bound explicitly catalogs reconciliation-host cap/target/adapter.
Exact sealed reconciliation-host selector alone narrows to reconciliation-host-only exact-plan contract. Ordinary init bind retains historical bounded filesystem planner.
Immutable rule restricted to init bind, derived binding actor, Architect initiator and provision operation; actual native repository/worktree and B5 remain enforced.
counterexamples: After seed success, second READY/prompt output fails: known custody retained, exit6.
Indeterminate native terminal with empty owned list followed by output/finalizer failure remains indeterminate.
Borrowed/cloned/used handle, changed scope or argv, missing TTY refuses.
EOF/wrong confirmation before effects cancels; after seed retains partial custody.
Mixed selectors, P1 or ordinary init bind cannot use provision capability.
qualification: Preimplementation review only; no installed/public success, refusal, concurrency or crash qualification claimed.
